Nicholas Eftimiades is a professor of homeland security at Penn State Harrisburg, teaching intelligence with a focus on Chinese espionage. He is retired from a thirty-four-year government career including the CIA, State Department, Diplomatic Security Service and Defense Intelligence Agency. His 1994 book, Chinese Intelligence Operations, was the first scholarly examination of the structure and methodology of the PRC's intelligence services.
